title: Zero-Maintenance Multi-Site Fleet on Cloudflare Pages
objective: Deploy a fleet of high-traffic content sites with client-friendly editing without running a single database or backend server.
results: Zero database vulnerabilities, zero patch cycles, and zero maintenance overhead.
Single-click git-native editorial flow via browser without SaaS subscriptions.
Global sub-20ms TTFB edge caching worldwide on Cloudflare Pages.
Instant rollbacks and version history backed natively by Git.
